en.title: Buying a SEKA bike: start with the dealer, then match the exact frame
en.description: Use SEKA’s current dealer directory, separate old reseller stories from today’s buying routes, and compare the right generation, build and support package.
en.intro: A long forum thread can tell you a great deal about an old SEKA order and very little about where you should buy today. Start with the current dealer network, then use owner experiences to sharpen the questions.

sections.heading: Use the current directory as your starting point
paragraphs: SEKA’s [global dealer directory](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/) lists sellers in Europe, the US and Canada. Locate a relevant dealer there, then ask for an exact model and size quote. The directory establishes a route to contact; it does not establish stock.

Compare a frameset offer with a dealer’s complete build only after listing the included cockpit, seatpost, headset and assembly. Ask who checks the finished bike and who handles a claim. Those services can matter as much as a small difference in frame price.

Confirm the frame generation and version in writing. The Spear RDC pictured here should not borrow specifications, weight claims or warranty outcomes from a non-RDC bike or an older Exceed simply because the logo matches.

sections.heading: Old reseller stories need their original context
paragraphs: In a [December 2022 Exceed discussion](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=3643.15), an owner described a roughly six-and-a-half-month wait through Cycling100, involving stock and communication problems in that period. This is historical context, not a recommendation to use that seller now.

A different [February 2024 owner discussion](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4757.0) included a US non-RDC owner who reported a good warranty experience. That does not prove how another seller or frame version would be handled.
Read these as separate transactions. Combining one person’s delivery delay with another person’s support outcome into a brand reliability score would create precision the evidence cannot support.

sections.heading: Ask what the dealer actually holds
paragraphs: Ask whether the frame is physically at the dealer, allocated at a distributor or still awaiting factory production. Request a dispatch estimate tied to that state. A dealer being able to order a size is not the same as having it ready for your workshop.

If you need a particular cockpit, confirm it before paying a deposit and ask whether the quoted fit can be achieved within the manufacturer’s adjustment limits. Have your fitter or assembler review the geometry and front-end choice.

Agree how a substitution will be approved. A different finish may be a matter of taste; a different bar size, seatpost or frame revision can change the build plan. None should quietly appear on the final invoice.

sections.heading: Make support a concrete part of the offer
paragraphs: Get the current warranty terms from the actual seller. Record claim contact, proof required, return destination and whether labor and transport are included. A nearby dealer helps most when its responsibilities are explicit.

Ask how to order a hanger, headset pieces and proprietary cockpit hardware after the sale. If a spare is inexpensive and difficult to source locally, ask the assembler whether buying one with the frame is sensible.

Choose the route that gives you an identifiable frame, a credible delivery plan and a named support path at a total you accept. A beautiful frame deserves a buying process with fewer mysteries than its forum history.

zh-Hans.title: SEKA 购车指南：先找经销商，再对齐具体车架
zh-Hans.description: 通过 SEKA 当前经销商名单选渠道，区分旧代理经历与今天的购买方式，并对齐代际、配置和售后。
zh-Hans.intro: 长论坛帖可能详细描述一笔老 SEKA 订单，却未必告诉你今天去哪买。先查当前经销网络，再用车主经历把问题问得更具体。

sections.heading: 先用当前经销商目录
paragraphs: [SEKA 全球经销商目录](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/)列有欧洲、美国和加拿大卖家。找到适合的经销商后，再询具体车型及尺码。目录提供联系路线，不证明现货。
比较车架套餐与经销商整车前，列清把组、座管、碗组和装配内容。问谁检查完成后的车、谁处理索赔。这些服务可能比车架小额价差更重要。
书面确认代际和版本。图中的 Spear RDC，不能因为标志相同，就沿用非 RDC 或老 Exceed 的规格、重量和保修结果。

sections.heading: 旧卖家故事要放回当时的背景
paragraphs: 在 [2022 年 12 月 Exceed 讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=3643.15)中，车主描述通过 Cycling100 购买、经历约六个半月等待，以及当时的库存和沟通问题。这是历史背景，不是今天的渠道推荐。
[2024 年 2 月另一讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4757.0)包含一位美国非 RDC 车主的积极保修经历。它不能证明另一卖家或版本会如何处理。
应将它们视为不同交易。把某人的交期和另一人的售后合成品牌可靠性评分，会制造证据并不支持的精确感。

sections.heading: 问清经销商手上有什么
paragraphs: 确认车架是在车店实物库存、已分配的代理库存，还是等待厂家生产。让发货估计与这个状态对应。“能订这个尺码”和“随时能送去装车”不同。
需要特定把组时，付定金前确认，并问能否在厂家调整限制内达到目标姿势。让 fitter 或装配者检查几何与前端方案。
约定配置替换如何征得同意。颜色变化可能只是偏好；把组、座管或车架版本变化会影响装车。它们不应悄悄出现在最后发票上。

sections.heading: 让售后成为明确报价的一部分
paragraphs: 向实际卖家取得当前保修条款，记录联系人、举证材料、退货地，以及是否含工时和运输。附近经销商的优势，在责任明确时最有价值。
问日后如何购买尾钩、碗组零件和专用把组硬件。某备用件若便宜却当地难找，可让装配者判断是否适合随车架一起买。
选择能明确车型、合理交期和售后路径，且总额可接受的渠道。漂亮车架值得拥有一套比论坛历史更清楚的购买流程。
